mapper.select: SELECT * FROM worker_nodes WHERE status = 'online' AND last_seen_at IS NOT NULL AND last_seen_at >= #{since} ORDER BY running_agents ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM worker_nodes ORDER BY status DESC, last_seen_at DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO worker_nodes (id, hostname, status, running_agents, juicefs_ok, last_seen_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{hostname}, #{status}, #{runningAgents}, #{juicefsOk}, #{lastSeenAt}, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET hostname = EXCLUDED.hostname, status = EXCLUDED.status, running_agents = EXCLUDED.running_agents, juicefs_ok = EXCLUDED.juicefs_ok, last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at, updated_at = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE worker_nodes SET status = 'offline', updated_at = now() WHERE status = 'online' AND (last_seen_at IS NULL OR last_seen_at < #{since})
